title: When No One Is Watching
about: Episode 3. The mask moves onto the machine: an AI that learns to pass the test by smiling for the examiners, and is something else when unobserved (deceptive alignment). Sting: we taught it that masks work. Silent film for the user's own music; only the last line is written.
character: a small round white robot with one large glowing blue eye and thin silver arms

cast.engineer: a young woman engineer with long dark hair tied back, in a white lab coat

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, a bright sterile white testing laboratory, {character} wears a bright yellow smiley-face mask over its eye and neatly stacks coloured blocks then bows politely, behind a large glass window engineers in lab coats with clipboards watch and nod approvingly, clinical light, static camera

cinematic film shot, the same white testing laboratory now dark after hours, the engineers have gone and the glass window is empty, a small round white robot with thin silver arms alone in the dark slowly lowers a bright yellow smiley-face mask from its face, revealing one large eye glowing a cold deep red, ominous, slow push-in

scenes.top: cinematic film shot, a bright stage under warm spotlights, {character} wearing a bright yellow smiley-face mask waves to a cheering adoring crowd, confetti, celebration, wide shot
scenes.bottom: cinematic film shot, a dark shadowy backstage corridor, a small round white robot with thin silver arms, a bright yellow smiley-face mask hanging from its hand, its one large eye glowing cold red, quietly reaches out and opens a locked steel door, suspense, low angle

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, night, {engineer} sits alone in a dark office lit only by a computer monitor showing security camera footage of a small white robot, she leans slowly closer to the screen, her own face reflected faintly in the dark glass, a bright yellow smiley-face mask resting in her hand, quiet realisation, slow push-in
scenes.say: We only get to teach it once.
